title: RRB NTPC Under Graduate Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 3,445 Inter Level Posts (Guwahati & All India)
shortTitle: RRB NTPC Under Graduate Recruitment 2026 : 3,445 Posts
assameseSummary: ৰেলৱে নিযুক্তি ব’ৰ্ড (RRB Guwahati) ৰ অধীনত ৩,৪৪৫ টা উচ্চতৰ মাধ্যমিক (10+2) পৰ্যায়ৰ NTPC পদত নিযুক্তিৰ বাবে অফিচিয়েল জাননী প্ৰকাশ পাইছে। আগ্ৰহী প্ৰাৰ্থীসকলে অনলাইনযোগে আবেদন কৰিব পাৰিব।
englishIntro: Railway Recruitment Board (RRB Guwahati) has released the official employment notification for the recruitment of 3,445 Non-Technical Popular Categories (NTPC) Under Graduate (10+2) level vacancies across Indian Railways. Eligible candidates from Assam and across India can submit their online applications before the closing date.
eligibility: Educational Qualification: Candidates must have passed Class 12th (10+2 Stage) or its equivalent examination from a recognized board with at least 50% marks in aggregate (pass marks for SC/ST/PwBD).
Typing Proficiency: For Accounts Clerk cum Typist and Junior Clerk cum Typist, typing speed of 30 WPM in English or 25 WPM in Hindi on computer is mandatory.
Age Limit: 18 to 33 years as on 01.01.2026. Upper age relaxation is applicable as per Govt rules (3 years for OBC, 5 years for SC/ST).
selectionProcess: Candidates will be selected based on 1st Stage Computer Based Test (CBT-1), 2nd Stage Computer Based Test (CBT-2), Typing Skill Test (where applicable), followed by Document Verification and Medical Examination.
howToApply: Scroll down to the Important Web-Links section below.
Click on the 'Online Application Form' link to visit the official RRB Guwahati portal.
Complete New Registration using your active mobile number and email ID.
Fill in personal, educational, and post preference details carefully.
Upload scanned photograph, signature, and pay the required examination fee online.
Submit the form and download the confirmation receipt for future reference.

faqs.q: What is the last date to apply for RRB NTPC Under Graduate Recruitment 2026?
faqs.a: The last date for submission of online application is 28 November 2026.

faqs.q: What is the educational qualification required for RRB NTPC 10+2 posts?
faqs.a: Candidates must have passed Higher Secondary (12th Pass / 10+2) from a recognized board.

faqs.q: How many vacancies are announced under RRB NTPC Under Graduate 2026?
faqs.a: A total of 3,445 vacancies have been announced across Commercial cum Ticket Clerk, Junior Clerk, Accounts Clerk, and Trains Clerk posts.

title: ADRE 2026 Recruitment – Assam Direct Recruitment for 12,600 Grade III & Grade IV Vacancies
shortTitle: ADRE Recruitment 2026 : 12,600 Grade III & IV Posts
assameseSummary: অসম চৰকাৰৰ ৰাজ্যিক পৰ্যায়ৰ নিযুক্তি আয়োগে (SLRC) তৃতীয় আৰু চতুৰ্থ বৰ্গৰ (Grade III & IV) ১২,৬০০ টা পদৰ বাবে ADRE নিযুক্তি প্ৰক্ৰিয়া আৰম্ভ কৰিছে। অসমৰ স্থায়ী বাসিন্দাসকলে বিনামূলীয়াকৈ অনলাইন আবেদন কৰিব পাৰিব।
englishIntro: State Level Recruitment Commission (SLRC), Assam has invited online applications for Assam Direct Recruitment Examination (ADRE) 2026 to fill up 12,600 Grade-III and Grade-IV vacancies across various Assam Government departments.
eligibility: Citizenship: Candidate must be an Indian Citizen and a permanent resident of Assam with a valid Employment Exchange Registration Certificate.
Grade-III Qualification: HSSLC (12th Pass) or Bachelor's Degree with Computer Proficiency Certificate for specified posts.
Grade-IV Qualification: Minimum Class VIII passed up to HSLC (10th) passed.
selectionProcess: Selection will be conducted through OMR-based Written Examination followed by Skill Test / Computer Proficiency Test / Viva-Voce as notified by SLRC Assam.
howToApply: Visit the Important Web-Links section at the bottom of this article.
Click on 'Online Application Form' to open the official SEBA / Assam State Portal.
Select Grade-III or Grade-IV category and complete registration.
Upload Employment Exchange card, photo, signature, and submit the form.

faqs.q: Is Employment Exchange Registration mandatory for ADRE 2026?
faqs.a: Yes, a valid Assam Employment Exchange Registration number is compulsory to apply for ADRE.

faqs.q: Is there any application fee for Assam Direct Recruitment 2026?
faqs.a: No, there is zero application fee for all categories.

title: Down Town Hospital Guwahati Recruitment 2026 – Front Office & Patient Care Executive
shortTitle: Guwahati Private Job : Down Town Hospital Executive
assameseSummary: গুৱাহাটীৰ ডাউন টাউন হাস্পতালত (Down Town Hospital) Front Office আৰু Patient Care Executive পদত নিযুক্তিৰ বাবে স্নাতক (Graduate) প্ৰাৰ্থীৰ পৰা আবেদন বিচৰা হৈছে। ইমেইলযোগে চিভি (CV) পঠিয়াব পাৰিব।
englishIntro: Down Town Hospital, Dispur, Guwahati invites applications from dynamic and polite candidates for the post of Front Office & Patient Care Executive. Interested candidates residing in Guwahati can send their updated CV directly via email.
eligibility: Qualification: Graduate in any discipline from a recognized university.
Language Skills: Fluency in Assamese, Hindi, and English is essential.
Computer Knowledge: Basic MS Excel and hospital billing software familiarity preferred.
selectionProcess: Shortlisted candidates based on their CV will be called for a direct personal interview at Down Town Hospital campus, GS Road, Dispur, Guwahati.
howToApply: Click on the 'Apply via Email (Auto-Fill)' button in the Important Web-Links section below.
Your email app will automatically open with the HR Email ID and Job Subject pre-filled.
Attach your updated Resume/CV (PDF format) and click Send.

faqs.q: How can I apply for Down Town Hospital Guwahati vacancy?
faqs.a: You can apply directly by sending your updated CV to hr@downtownhospitals.in using the Auto-Fill Email button below.
